subject.title: fix(openai): correct live model and packaged onboarding failures

question: Should OpenAI onboarding intentionally show no static model fallback when account discovery succeeds with an empty list or returns 401/403, after the branch is refreshed onto current `main`?
rationale: This is an intentional provider-auth and user-selection policy boundary: tests can verify the implementation, but only an owner can confirm that suppressing fallback choices for those account states is the desired product contract.

options.title: Land after exact-head refresh
options.body: Refresh the branch against current `main` and confirm the provider and packed onboarding proofs retain the intended empty/401/403 behavior.

options.title: Preserve a fallback for authorization failures
options.body: Change only the 401/403 policy if maintainers want existing static model choices to remain visible until credentials are revalidated.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current `main` and confirm the provider and packed onboarding proofs retain the intended empty/401/403 behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the preceding merged account-model onboarding implementation and this directly related follow-up.
